name: Private Proof E2E Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: private-proof-benchmark-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: true
          fetch-depth: 0
          cache-node-modules: true
          node-version: 20
          skip-allow-scripts: false
          yarn-install-max-retries: 3

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run private-proof E2E benchmark
        run: yarn benchmark:private:e2e

      - name: Publish benchmark results
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Private Proof E2E Benchmark
          tool: node
          output-file-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/latest.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          benchmark-data-dir-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          auto-push: true
          skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
          comment-always: false
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: 200
